summary: P01 V2.47.233 fixes Owner-reported category sort/display drift in Navigation. Sort mode now derives its visible rows from the actual Navigation category tree, mirrors the same hierarchy/expansion model, and hides zero-content/currently hidden categories from the sort UI. Visible moves are merged back into the complete active sibling slots before calling canonical category_reorder, preserving backend completeness and hidden-sibling order. Functional Contract and Acceptance UX-49 require sort/display parity plus complete-sibling persistence. No Schema/Migration, no second Category Authority, no auth/session/security semantic change, no updater mechanism change, no provider/server write and no Production write. Production remains Owner-manual.
